Container.Name: nod-runtime
Container.Overview:
Nod (2 of 6): filtered Docker API gateway, using upstream's docker-proxy.mjs. It holds the Docker socket but only allows nod-server to run commands inside nod-workspace-unraid and nod-browser-unraid. Every other Docker request is refused. Unofficial community packaging, not affiliated with n8n GmbH.
Keep the container name and the two container-name variables unchanged unless you also change them in nod-server.
Container.Requires: The "nod" Docker network (docker network create nod). Part of the Nod app: install all six nod-* templates.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket. Requests are filtered to exec into the two Nod containers only.

Config.Name: Workspace container
Config.Description: Name of the workspace container (must start with nod-workspace-).

Config.Name: Browser container
Config.Description: Name of the browser container (must start with nod-browser-).
